label: Inkjet supertank all-in-one, wired + wireless
description: Cartridge-free colour inkjet all-in-one (15/8 ISO ppm) with 10/100 Ethernet and 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi. Wireless setup often leaves the wired port idle but link-up.
notes: Both wired (10/100) and wireless (2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n). No PoE, external 100-240 VAC supply. Wi-Fi Direct AP mode is also available, so it can act as a soft AP in isolation.
